Meta.title: Meta
Meta.lead: Every legend placed by power, calculated from tournament results. Power mixes adjusted win rate and how often the legend reaches the top 25% of an event.

Methodology.title: How we calculate
Methodology.winRate: Win rate counts wins and losses only; draws and byes are left out, and so are mirror matches. Every rate shows a 95% Wilson confidence interval.
Methodology.adjusted: Adjusted win rate adds 100 imaginary matches at 50%, so a legend with few games does not jump to the top by luck.
Methodology.conversion: Top 25% rate compares how many pilots of a legend finished in the top quarter of the Swiss standings with how many would be expected from its presence (1.00× is average).
Methodology.power: Power is the percentile (0 to 100) of 60% adjusted win rate plus 40% top 25% rate, both standardized. Tiers: S from 90, A from 70, B from 40, C from 15, D below.
Methodology.pilots: Best pilots are ranked by the lower bound of the 95% Wilson interval, with the sample size reduced by Kish's design effect, because matches from the same event are not fully independent.
Methodology.minimum: A legend needs at least {min} pilots in the selected set to enter the chart.
Methodology.source: Data comes from the public pages of official events on the organized play platform (UVS). The legend of each player is the one registered there; full decklists are not public.
